notes:
Emirate of Trarza, additions batch af-03-x; Cliopatria has no row. Page: Emirate of Trarza.

The page has no end and no formal annexation; the French protectorate of 15 December 1902 sets the end here, while the last emir ruled to 1932. The page lists Trarza's influence over Waalo, Cayor and Jolof "south of the river", which was influence, not land, and is not drawn. The Trarza-Brakna war of 1720-22 (competing for influence in Waalo and Futa Toro) is on the Brakna page, not on this one; the pact of Trarza with Brakna against French expansion is undated. The Char Bouba War is dated 1673-77 on the Brakna page and 1644-1674 on the History of Mauritania page; neither is used for an event. The Emirate of Adrar page returned the colonial history of Mauritania and the Tagant page the plateau: neither state has a dossier (page silent).
Gazetteer: Mederdra, Rosso, Chemama, Portendick, Jubuldu (Dioubouldy).
